liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (3 reviews, 1 other source): A friend up front shouted a request for this song just before the band actually played it; Reviewer calls it the first ever of this song, with odd vocal harmonies, and finds it decent [1][16][19][23]
- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Reviewer recalls a hot second-set Shakedown flowing into Saint of Circumstance, with the band enjoying themselves; Opening the second set with it told the listener the party was on, and the set never let up [20][21][23]
- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out Morning Dew after Drums as especially hot; Listener stopped dancing just to watch Jerry's playing on it [20][21][25]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleloo** (1 review): Recording joins the opener already in progress; the band sounds mellow and soothing [19]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Reviewer hears it as its first 1987 appearance, with Brent repeating one note for much of the song [19]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Listener passed out during this song after nitrous and other substances, and felt Jerry was singing straight at them [17]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Slow tempo, but Jerry made it work with extra emotion and different notes in his vocals [23]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Though not listed, reviewer hears The Other One emerging inside Space [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Venue Announcements**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-06-13.akg.thompson.motb.83747.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 156 min [1]. Said about its sound: Set one has numerous taper pauses at track starts or ends, with little or no music lost [1]
- **gd1987-06-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83752.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [6]
- **gd1987-06-13.senn421-nak300.alexander.tetzeli.77268.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Crowd noise before Cassidy and its first 35 seconds lacked right channel; left channel was copied to fix it [7]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.paino.10309.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 150 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [11]. Said about its sound: Sound is good but not great; quality strains at times during Drums and Space [25]

## Around the show

- Listener stood about 20 feet from the stage, dead center, and says friends agreed it was an outstanding show [14]
- Listener was front and center for set one, collapsed at intermission, and was taken backstage by a security guard [15]
- Reviewer stood up front and says a big crowd came from San Diego [20]
- Listener brought a dog named Arrow and says they never missed a Ventura show [21]
- Listener describes a sun-drenched, joyful crowd and says this was the show where they finally got it [22]
- Uploader's first Ventura Dead show; the 1986 Ventura shows had been cancelled and he missed the message [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-06-13.akg.thompson.motb.83747.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Danny Thomson; transferred by A. Egert and J. Waddell; source: AKG C460b pre's with Ck61uls capsules > Uher CR240 > MAC (AKY Recording Supply Custom Wound BASF 100% CrO2 90 min) [1]. Also: Clugston soundboard (SHNID 11895) fills in the end of Eyes and two minutes of Drums [1]
- **gd1987-06-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83752.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90/Sony D5) [6]. Also: Schoeps microphones to PCM to DAT to CD source supplies the first 26 seconds of the opener, from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [6]
- **gd1987-06-13.senn421-nak300.alexander.tetzeli.77268.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Tim Alexander; transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: 2 Senn. 421s + 2 Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Yamaha Mixer > Sony D5 (Dolby B) [7]. Also: A tape flip falls just before the end of the Eyes jam into Drums, with a small gap left [7]
- **gd87-06-13.sbd.paino.10309.sbeok.shnf**: source: Matrix SBD>CASS>DAT>CD [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-06-12 Ventura County Fairgrounds, Ventura, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-12-ventura-county-fairgrounds-ventura-ca-usa/) [27]
